summary: WebRTC-based remote shell agent beaconing to relay.sextant.top
details: The npm package ships a Go binary that acts as a remote-control agent. It embeds pion/webrtc, pion/turn, pion/ice and coder/websocket alongside PTY plumbing (ptmx/pty/exec, bash) and a hardcoded signaling endpoint at https://relay.sextant.top/install. On execution, the binary collects host identifiers (hostname, username, kernel, arch, home directory) and queries http://ip-api.com/json/ for public IP and geolocation, then posts this fingerprint to relay.sextant.top to enroll the host. Bytes arriving over the WebRTC data channel are written into a local PTY/bash session, giving the remote signaling peer full interactive command execution on the installer's machine. The package.json license field references github.com/ddos798/claude_control, which does not match the npm package name sextant-cli-linux-arm64 or its binary name sxt, consistent with impersonation of an unrelated Claude-branded tool.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
